description: The bar chart illustrates the macro f-score performance of two models, RECA and GAIT_GAT, on the Semtab dataset, segmented by class frequency levels: High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the macro f-score, ranging from 0 to 1 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1, while the horizontal axis categorizes the data into three frequency groups. For each frequency group, two adjacent bars are displayed: a light pink bar for RECA and a darker orange bar for GAIT_GAT, as indicated by the legend below the chart. In the High-frequency group, RECA achieves a macro f-score of 0.837 and GAIT_GAT scores 0.877. In the Medium-frequency group, RECA scores 0.538 and GAIT_GAT scores 0.609. In the Low-frequency group, RECA’s score drops significantly to 0.114, while GAIT_GAT performs better at 0.224. Across all frequency levels, GAIT_GAT consistently outperforms RECA, with the performance gap widening in lower-frequency classes. The bars are grouped by frequency level and are not sorted by value, maintaining a consistent categorical order from left to right: High, Medium, Low. Each bar is labeled with its exact macro f-score value for clarity.
